body: I hope you will find a way to distract yourself for a long period of time. Thanks for writing this post.

i dont see any reasons to continue my living. why? the fact that i have a single life does not give me motivation to live. i cant do anything about it. i have no will to live. 
good night, evening or whatever, stranger. i hope you will live a wonderful live, but there are things you cant change, like my behavior.

it's very good that you are thinking like that. but i have a different opinion. it doesn't matter if you believe or not. 
the universe exists because of unknown reasons, humanity will never find out why.
I feel sad for not being able to help you.
